papers.title: CADER: Confidence-Aware Dynamic Evidence Reasoning for Long-Video Understanding
papers.authors: Jinlong Yang, Wenhao Zhang, Kuanwei Lin, Sijie Cheng
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Northwestern Polytechnical University; School of Electronic and Computer Engineering, Peking University; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: CADER是一个训练-free的长视频推理框架，通过置信度（logit margin）将样本分为简单/困难两类：高置信样本直接早期退出，低置信样本进入由时间裁剪、轻量语义验证和相关性引导重采样构成的工具增强闭环搜索，从而在提升长视频问答性能的同时避免不必要的工具计算。

papers.title: The Visual Bottleneck: Sparse-Frame Adaptation of MLLMs for Joint Spatial-Temporal Video Grounding
papers.authors: Jiameng Zhang, Srikanth Madikeri
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了稀疏帧输入下多模态大语言模型进行时空视频定位的训练策略，发现视觉特征提取是主要瓶颈，仅微调最后三层ViT（4%参数）即可大幅超越零样本密集输入的8B模型，并提出了边界感知采样策略Hybrid16。

papers.title: TimePLE: Rethinking Temporal Representation for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Yuhui Zeng, Xinyu Mao, Xiaokun Liu, Xin Tao, Jinfa Huang, Jiayi Ji, Xiawu Zheng
papers.affiliations: Media Analytics and Computing Lab, Xiamen University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; Department of Computer Science, University of Rochester; Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology
papers.intro: TimePLE通过将视频时间定位从端点预测重构为区间本位预测，利用VLM生成的单个<|TIMESPAN|> token在规范位置-时长平方上解码出一个联合区间分布，从而直接输出连续时间边界。

papers.title: LabRobFail: A Benchmark for Robotic Failure Analysis in Chemical Self-driving Laboratories
papers.authors: Haobo Wang, Baoli Sun, Anqi Zou, Dongsheng Huang, Zelin Lv, Ning Wang, Rui Li, Dongzhan Zhou, Weiyu Guo, Zhihui Wang, Wanli Ouyang
papers.affiliations: Dalian University of Technology, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone, Harbin Institute of Technology, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出LabRobFail——一个面向化学自驱动实验室机器人失败分析的框架，包含可控失败注入的仿真平台、大规模多类型失败数据集（超20,000条轨迹、11种细粒度失败类型）以及六维度评估基准，并开发了领域专用VLM实现结构化失败诊断与恢复，显著提升下游任务成功率。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM3 for Prompt-Driven Surgical Concept Segmentation
papers.authors: Changjing Liu, Yiming Huang, Beilei Cui, Liangjing Shao, Long Bai, Yanheng Li, Haoxuan Che, Hongliang Ren
papers.affiliations: 1 Department of Electronic Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR, China; 2 XGEN Labs
papers.intro: 本文提出一种参数高效的LoRA适配方法，仅更新SAM3中0.98%的参数（训练内存降至9GB），在多个手术数据集上显著优于零样本SAM3和全微调Medical SAM3，并直接支撑下游手术场景重建与物理仿真。

papers.title: Perturbation-Aware Diffusion-Guided Hybrid Segmentation for Robust and Annotation-Efficient Plant Stress Phenotyping
papers.authors: Gurbhit Chaurakoti, Soumyashree Kar
papers.affiliations: National Institute of Technology Delhi（Gurbhit Chaurakoti）；Indian Institute of Technology Bombay（Soumyashree Kar）
papers.intro: 提出一种扩散引导的混合分割框架，通过U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer骨干与DDPM、潜在扩散或语义引导扩散三种细化器配对，结合扰动感知的重训练策略和边界约束优化，在资源受限条件下实现了对植物胁迫图像的鲁棒且标注高效的分割。

papers.title: Contrastive Parameter Disentanglement for Multi-modal Remote Sensing Image Generation
papers.authors: Yu Zhang, Wenda Zhao, Haojun Tang, Haipeng Wang
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Yu Zhang, Wenda Zhao, Haojun Tang - School of Information and Communication Engineering, Dalian University of Technology; Haipeng Wang - Unit 92728 of PLA, Shanghai
papers.intro: 本文提出对比参数解缠框架（CPD），通过利用LoRA参数的功能二分性在正交核心子空间内实现语义与模态属性的参数级解缠，并结合查询-键结构转移机制，实现从单一文本提示生成语义一致、结构对齐的高保真多模态遥感图像。

papers.title: RRTrack: Robust and Recoverable Object 6D Pose Tracking for Dynamic Scenes
papers.authors: Junyue Li, Ye Zheng, Yifan Chen, Zhe Sun, Xuelong Li
papers.affiliations: 未明确（各作者所属机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: RRTrack提出一种无需训练的可恢复物体6D姿态跟踪框架，通过2D-6D闭环跟踪（结合视频物体分割和CAD模型精化）和DINOv2双库模板匹配，在快速运动和遮挡消失-重现场景下实现鲁棒跟踪，并在合成基准上相比FoundationPose将ADD-S AR提升66.3%、AUC提升65.7%。

papers.title: WGDnet: Wishart-guided Geometric-aware Deep Network for PolSAR Image Classification
papers.authors: Junfei Shi, Haojia Zhang, Yu Cheng, Yuke Li
papers.intro: 本文提出WGDNet，一种融合可学习Wishart统计建模、方向先验引导聚合和几何自适应卷积的端到端PolSAR图像分类网络。

papers.title: PathSelect: Sequential Token Selection for Whole Slide Pathology
papers.authors: Jingzhi Chen, Landi He, Zehong Chen, Peihang Wu, Lijian Xu
papers.intro: 本文提出PathSelect，一个将WSI令牌剪枝重新定义为门控顺序选择的可学习框架，通过可微分的软Top-K与噪声门控结合对角线注意力去噪器实现端到端连续优化，在冻结SlideChat模型基础上实现36.6倍令牌压缩且准确率超越采样基准。

papers.title: JarvisHub: An Open Harness for Canvas-Native Multimodal Creative Agents
papers.authors: Yunlong Lin, Zixu Lin, Zhaohu Xing, Biqiang Li, Chenxin Li, Haonan Wang, Haitao Wu, Hengyu Liu, Jianghai Chen, Kaituo Feng, Kaixin Li, Shawn Chen, Shijue Huang, Sixiang Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho, Wenxuan Huang, Xiangyan Liu, Xiaomeng Hu, Xuanhua He, Yan Sun, Yunqing Zhao, Zhiqin Yang, Zehan Wang, Zhengyang Tang, Tianyu Pang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.tags: image generation, video generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: JarvisX Team（论文第一页标注"JarvisX Team"）
papers.intro: JarvisHub是一个画布原生（canvas-native）创意代理框架，通过将可编辑画布作为用户工作空间、代理外部记忆、动作空间和共享项目状态，实现长时间多模态创意任务的持续自动化，同时允许用户全程检查、引导和干预。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Object Detection: An In-Depth Study and Future Directions
papers.authors: Jianing Li, Dianze Li, Arren Glover, Xiaopeng Fan, Guoqi Li, Chiara Bartolozzi, Ryad B. Benosman, Yonghong Tian
papers.tags: object detection, autonomous driving, edge deployment, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: 北京大学、哈尔滨工业大学、意大利技术研究所、卡内基梅隆大学、中国科学院自动化研究所
papers.intro: 本文全面调查和基准测试了神经形态目标检测算法，系统梳理了问题定义、数据集、评估指标，从事件表示、时间建模、多模态融合、异步处理、低延迟和节能计算六个视角分类方法，并通过大量实验对比揭示了不同范式的优劣，最后展望了未来方向。

papers.title: MOJITO: Modal Joint Learning for Unified End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Zhijing Cheng, Xuancheng Zhang, Donglin Di, Lei Fan, Baorui Ma, Hao Li, Xun Yang
papers.affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China; Li Auto; University of New South Wales
papers.intro: MOJITO提出一个基于模态联合学习的统一端到端驾驶框架，通过模态联合注意力机制在每一Transformer块中同时更新动作、图像和LiDAR特征，消除了级联信息瓶颈，在NAVSIM基准上达到新的最优性能，且无需手工锚点或辅助监督。

papers.title: Similarity Is Not Logic: Factored Inference for Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Sultan Alshehri, Zhantao Yang, Han Zhang, Marios Savvides
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA, USA
papers.intro: 论文提出因子化推理（Factored Inference）与逻辑约束分数编辑（LCSE），将证据提取与约束执行分离，利用冻结编码器得到概念分数并在外部执行布尔逻辑，从而无需训练即可修复双编码器VLM的组合约束失败，同时保持标准检索性能。

papers.title: Active few-shot segmentation by reinforcing data selection
papers.authors: Chenlan Zhao, Benny Wong, Timothy F. Lundberg, Ahmed M. Elsayed, Abdallah Aljarkas, Hamad A. Aljamaan, Lynn Karam, Qianye Yang, Yipeng Hu, Claire C. Villette, Shaheer U. Saeed
papers.affiliations: Queen Mary University of London (Centre for Bioengineering; Digital Environment Research Institute), University College London (UCL Hawkes Institute), University of Oxford, Yale University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的支持集选择框架，通过直接优化下游分割性能来联合选择多个样本组成支持集，在跨机构盆腔MRI数据集上显著优于随机选择和现有主动选择方法。

papers.title: StateAct: Program State, before Pixels, for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Yan Yang, Xiangru Jian, Ziyang Luo, Zirui Zhao, Yutong Dai, Ziji Shi, Hanshu Yan, Jun Hao Liew, Silvio Savarese, Junnan Li
papers.intro: StateAct提出一种代码优先的多智能体框架，让主智能体通过直接操作程序状态（文件、后端、DOM等）来执行长期计算机使用任务，并辅以独立的基于状态的完成验证和上下文管理，在OSWorld 2.0上大幅超越同模型的纯截图基线，同时降低成本约9倍。

papers.title: SLIP: Segmentation with Low-latency Interactive Prompting for 3D Medical Images
papers.authors: Baptiste Podvin, Alexandre Ancel, Flavio Milana, Chiara Innocenzi, Davide Arrigo, Federico Espinola Schulze, Guido Torzilli, Jacques Marescaux, Daniel George, Alexandre Hostettler, Toby Collins
papers.affiliations: IRCAD France, Strasbourg, France; Université de Strasbourg, CNRS, ICube, Strasbourg, France; Division of Hepatobiliary and General Surgery, Department of Surgery, IRCCS Humanitas Research Hospital, Milan, Italy; Department of Biomedical Sciences, Humanitas University, Milan, Italy; Unità Operativa Complessa Ginecologia Oncologica, Dipartimento di Scienze Della Salute Della Donna e Del Bambino, Fondazione Policlinico Universitario A. Gemelli, Istituto di Ricovero e Cura a Carattere Scientifico (IRCCS), Rome, Italy
papers.intro: SLIP提出一种端到端可训练的交互式3D医学图像分割框架，通过解耦图像编码与提示引导细化、引入轻量级补丁记忆库实现低延迟、高响应性和可逆提示，在13个公开数据集上取得SOTA性能，并通过受控真实用户研究验证了其优于现有方法。

papers.title: LayoutLite: Token-Level Implicit Layout Analysis for Efficient Document OCR
papers.authors: Xudong Liu, Bicheng Wan, Yulin Jin
papers.intro: 本文提出LayoutLite，一种轻量级的即插即用模块，通过在视觉编码器与语言解码器之间进行token级别的隐式布局分析，识别并丢弃低信息量的视觉token，从而在不需微调原始VLM的前提下实现文档OCR推理的显著加速。

papers.title: JustDepth: Real-Time Radar-Camera Depth Estimation with Single-Scan LiDAR Supervision
papers.authors: Wooyung Yun, Dongwook Kim, Soomok Lee
papers.intro: JustDepth是一种单阶段雷达-相机深度估计器，通过固定宽度1D雷达表示、高度融合块和轻量GNN实现实时推理（14.8ms），仅使用单扫描LiDAR监督且无需辅助标注，在保持精度的同时推理速度提升39.7倍、条纹伪影减少66%。

papers.title: Visual Relocalization from Sparse Views in Aliased and Low-Texture Environments via Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Maria Peribañez, Javier Civera, Rudolph Triebel, Riccardo Giubilato
papers.tags: pose estimation, 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, LiDAR, point cloud
papers.affiliations: University of Zaragoza (1,2), German Aerospace Center (DLR) (2,3), Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) (3)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种结合多视图立体（MVS）深度/法向指导和LiDAR点云Chamfer损失的几何感知3D高斯溅射（3DGS）训练策略，用于稀疏视角、低纹理环境下的单图像6自由度相机姿态估计，显著提升重定位鲁棒性。
